searchText: Can someone unlock the discussion-to thread for ERC 3009 on Github? I think it was closed by mistake because the ERC still links the closed thread, though it’s also possible there is a new undocumented thread somewhere. Please unlock discussion https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/3010 I ended up making a new thread in ethereum-magicians
